summary: Backcountry skier caught in a wet-slab avalanche at the Climax Chutes on Mt. Emmons, carried into trees and killed.
location: Climax Chutes, Mt. Emmons, near Crested Butte
responding_agency: Gunnison County Sheriff's Office; Crested Butte Mountain Rescue
notes: Victim a Crested Butte local in his 40s with extensive backcountry experience; party of four; victim not buried but sustained fatal trauma; on-scene resuscitation attempted; 6th CO avalanche fatality of the season. MERGED (run 114): CBN 2020-04-29 account — Dan Escalante, 44, former Crested Butte town councilman, in a party of four (only he was caught in the wet slab); not buried, carried into trees ~10:45 a.m. Tuesday; friends attempted resuscitation at the scene; CBMRT recovery mission early Wednesday morning (completed before noon); Gunnison County coroner: "multiple traumatic injuries due to a ski accident".
